passage:
recommend — 建议，推荐
A city council in the town of Riverton planned to recommend that all residents install smart water meters to reduce household water use.

consumption — 消耗量，消费
The report claimed that smart meters could cut water consumption by up to 30 percent.

pilot — 试点，试验
However, before making the recommendation official, the council decided to run a six-month pilot study in two neighborhoods: Northside and Southside.

feedback — 反馈
In Northside, 200 households received smart meters with real-time feedback displays.

confusing — 令人困惑的
Many Northside residents said they found the displays confusing.

voluntary — 自愿的
Instead of requiring smart meters for everyone, it proposed a voluntary program combining simple weekly emails with optional in-home displays for those who wanted more detail.

conservation — 保护，节约
Both groups received the same information about water conservation, so the comparison focused on the technology itself.

expanding — 扩展，扩大
They suggested a larger study before expanding the program citywide.
